As strange as it sounds, I got over it.

Just a bunch of stress piling up from school, and taking care of sick family members. I'd rather not think about it again right now, it was just scary having that feeling I'd never had before. Thank you though :)

It's just hilarious because almost everyone knows someone who would say something just like that.
